Akwa Ibom:
The Akwa Ibom State Chapter of the Nigerian Institute of Quantity Surveyors brings together quantity surveyors practising across Akwa Ibom State, in the South South geopolitical zone. Inaugurated in 1991, the chapter serves a membership working mostly in public infrastructure, education and housing projects across the state.

Working with the National Secretariat, the chapter runs regular continuing professional development sessions and an annual state workshop, distinguished annual lecture series. It engages the state’s ministries and agencies on procurement and cost management, and supports students through its links with universities in the state and the Young Quantity Surveyors Forum.

Quantity Surveyors in Akwa Ibom State can take part in chapter activities by contacting the chapter secretariat.
